summary: The diff implements most requirements successfully. The admin dashboard is fully functional with server and plan management. Server creation, assignment (to users/plans), and deletion are implemented with proper UI components. Plan creation/editing with billing periods and Stripe integration are present. First admin authentication logic was added (autoAssignAdminOnLogin in useActor.ts). However, some acceptance criteria are not fully verifiable from the truncated diff, particularly around server status display granularity, server creation default status, and the full extent of Stripe webhook validation.

missing_requirements.requirement: Each server displays status (active, inactive, pending)
missing_requirements.reason: The backend defines ServerStatus as #available, #assigned, #decommissioned, but the requirement specifies active/inactive/pending. The frontend AdminPage.tsx is truncated before the server table rendering code, so it's unclear if the status mapping matches the requested statuses or if all three requested status types are displayed correctly.

missing_requirements.requirement: Server is created with 'available' status by default
missing_requirements.reason: The CreateServerDialog and backend createDedicatedServer function are truncated. While the backend defines ServerStatus with #available, the actual implementation of the create function that sets the default status is not visible in the diff summary.
